grounding.observation: C15 initial clearance succeeded at59.198mm but settle exceeded90mm at100.539mm. Actual retained-mesh orthographic plots show dense sleeve-ring clustering and buckled forearm topology, plus excess square torso width. The rectangular armhole's nonuniform angular sampling was carried unchanged to every circular cuff ring. Measured torso half-width is149mm at waist versus205mm in the pattern. Correct these construction defects before another solve.
grounding.comparison: No image exists for9–12; no visual improvement is inferred.

expert_coverage.observation: Garment construction, joint ownership, rest arc distance, collision and appearance interfaces have concrete tests.
expert_coverage.comparison: Face, crown and tack remain blocking dependencies, not optional polish.

film_alignment.observation: Accepted Pashtun remains the integrated material/form floor.
film_alignment.comparison: Supporting status and night lighting do not authorize mannequin appearance.

preferences.observation: Continue internally through known failures; no cosmetic Director handoff.
preferences.comparison: Five is a shared correction ceiling, not five new tasks.

reference_roles.observation: Protected Pashtun is appearance quality authority; rearing reference is faithful action authority.
reference_roles.comparison: Neither is a neutral garment pattern or proof of successful cloth simulation.

method.observation: Actual data plots demonstrate clustered vertices and folded sleeve faces; measured source width demonstrates excess waist material. This changes initial construction rather than stiffness or guards. Uniform distal spacing must be checked against collision distances, and fitted shoulders may remain problematic.
method.comparison: The fillet can still pinch inside the elbow; stability alone cannot qualify tailoring. Examine retained points before any further change.

interfaces.observation: Preserved raw elbow/cuff coordinates, original207-pose donor and barycentric transfer. Complete shoulder/neck/waist/cuff/sash checks remain required.
interfaces.comparison: Nearest triangle binding can jump surfaces; actual stance/crest/reverse evidence is mandatory.

efficient_quality.observation: One leader and one near actor, cheap native proof before renders and propagation.
efficient_quality.comparison: No full sequence rerender or detailing a rejected torso.

authority.observation: Same appearance task16/17 under340. No spend or motion allowance change.
authority.comparison: Original failed attempts and quality floor remain intact.

strongest_counterexample: Evenly sampled sleeves and a fitted waist can still produce wrong armpit topology or stiff shoulder support. A numerical save is not a garment pass; reverse and bent-arm images must reject ridges, penetrations and anatomical-shirt appearance. Whole-character appearance is still open.
